description: T4.3: Fix manifest uses-feature and externalize hardcoded strings from feature screens
steps: Change manifest uses-feature from GLES 3.0 required=true to GLES 2.0 required=false with comment
Add string resources for all static hardcoded text in feature screens
Replace hardcoded text with stringResource(R.string.xxx) in composables
Add necessary imports for stringResource and R
acceptance_criteria: Static hardcoded strings moved to strings.xml
Feature composables use stringResource() for static text
findings: Manifest fixed: GLES 3.0 required=true changed to GLES 2.0 required=false with comment explaining Compose Canvas does not use raw OpenGL ES. 34 new string resources added to strings.xml covering auth, backtest, chart, portfolio, scanner, and settings screens. 6 feature files updated with stringResource() calls. Dynamic strings (format/interpolation) left as-is since they cannot be simple string resources. All XML validated as well-formed.
